question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
solution:
Table show alphabet serial number –

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286550159bb1b1af83b0ffca14b226c7cea8abbacc574e15aefc51c80aadcc47.png] 

The pattern followed is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b9a3fb1cca3fe2d78253c45310684de7044ec388bd1c90fd1a44f304e153ed1.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/315ab01a804bbebb76135e138684ec1377729076555d602767f327ff5a54243a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e62106b518d19f2da8a66ebfca17133227c451c8a66f6261a323cdcd3d51146c.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9de369bd180a3d5793f0e0bf33f0cf78aa7bda6aaca1c516257da2a9970ea85a.png] 

All follow the same pattern, except 'NMP’.

Hence, “NMP” is the odd one.
